description: TryfactaConnex Signs MoU with UP Govt for 1 GW AI Data Centre, Announces USD 7.7 Bn Investment
body_lead: TryfactaConnex Signs MoU with UP Govt for 1 GW AI Data Centre, Announces USD 7.7 Bn Investment TryfactaConnex, an affiliate of Tryfacta, Inc., has signed an MoU with the Government of Uttar Pradesh, at the AI Impact Summit 2026, to invest USD 7.7 billion in a 1 GW hyperscale AI campus, aiming to build an AI data energy complex integrating grid, nuclear, gas, and solar power. February 21, 2026.
